whenToUse: Project milestones, product roadmaps and release histories, stacked or laid out in a row
Activity feeds and logs such as git events, deploy runs and team member actions
Progress through ordered stages, such as order shipping or a build pipeline

whenNotToUse.when: A ready made activity feed, approval tracker or changelog to drop into a page
A full page audit log of access events grouped by day, with filters and export
A multi step form or setup flow the user clicks through, one panel at a time

agentNotes: `onValueChange` never fires, since no part changes the step on click or key; progress moves only when you pass a new `value`
`defaultValue` is 1 when omitted, which sets `data-completed` on the `TimelineItem` with `step` 1; pass 0 when nothing is done yet
Keep each `TimelineItem` a direct child of `Timeline`; wrapping one in an element hides its `TimelineSeparator` as if it were the last item
